message: a value allocated in the recovery point (reclaimed on abort) is stored into parameter `v` of `vecPush`, which lives in this function's own region (its caller's current region) - `vecPush` stores a value it allocates into that parameter

related.label: this scope reclaims the stored value before the destination is used

help: this store or call crosses a reclamation boundary: move it to the destination's outer scope, or keep the destination and every use inside the value's region; keeping another reference cannot postpone the reset

message: a recovery point's thunk has to be a lambda written at the call, or a top-level function
help: an abort reclaims everything the thunk allocated, so the thunk is held to storing none of it anywhere older; that is checked on a lambda written here, and a top-level function captures nothing. Write the lambda at the call
